title: Telium homeserver registry
description: Operator-supplied facts and preferences about a homeserver. Everything a machine can verify — registration status, version, roles, feature flags, uptime — is probed rather than declared.

domain.description: The server's Telium domain — the part after the colon in @user:domain. Not a URL, and not the API host if the domain delegates via .well-known.

description.description: One sentence. Who runs it and who it is for.

label.description: Where the server physically is, as a person would say it.

size_band.description: Approximate registered accounts. Self-reported by the operator: the server exposes no account count, so there is nothing to verify this against and the directory labels it as declared.

contact.description: A URL a person can actually reach you at — homepage, contact page, or mailto:.

recommendations.description: Explicit operator consent for this server to be considered for automatic beginner account-home recommendations. Omit it or set opt_in=false to stay directory-only. Live server capabilities must independently opt in too.

added.description: Date this entry was merged, ISO 8601.
